body:
NEW MERGE RULE (advisor, effective now, until STORY-1690 ships):
Before each pinned merge, if origin/main has moved since the PR's last green Build, update the branch from main first:
- use 'gh pr update-branch <n>' (a merge commit, no force push), or merge main through an implementer;
- wait for Build to go green at the NEW head;
- merge with --match-head-commit at that head.
If the update is base-only (git range-diff shows only main's changes), the existing approval stands and no re-review is needed.
Why: #2599 and #2597 were each green on their own base and together turned main red (71d04b3609).
subject: Rule: update branch from main before each merge (STORY-1690 stopgap)
